profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary:
As a Senior iOS Developer at 1Password, I work with a talented team of engineers, designers, and product managers to create a secure and user-friendly iOS app that helps millions of people manage their passwords and online identities. I have over 5 years of experience in iOS development, using both SwiftUI and UIKit frameworks, and I am always eager to learn and apply new technologies and best practices.

I am also passionate about building my own iOS app, Dekimasu, which is a comprehensive and interactive tool for learning Japanese kanji and other aspects of the language. I started this project in 2019, and since then I have written it entirely in SwiftUI, using only first-party Apple frameworks like Core Data and CloudKit. I enjoy designing and developing features that enhance the user experience and offer personalized feedback and progress tracking. My goal is to make learning Japanese fun and accessible for anyone who wants to master this beautiful and challenging language.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
Dekimasu is an iOS app I created for learning Japanese kanji and eventually vocabulary, grammar, etc.

It is written entirely in SwiftUI using only first party Apple frameworks like Core Data, CloudKit, etc.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Helped develop 1Password 8 with SwiftUI and Rust Core, optimizing performance and client-backend communication.
• Improved onboarding flows, increasing AutoFill adoption and user retention.
• Built the Home tab with customizable sections, enhancing navigation and feature accessibility.
• Led the import guide flow, enabling smooth migration of data from other password managers and CSVs.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the Last Mile iOS platform by collaborating with feature teams to integrate scalable delivery solutions.
• Developed experimental features in the Amazon Mobile Shopping app to enhance native user experience by reducing web views and using native UI components.
• Modernized the app’s UI by implementing native features and animations, such as an animated splash screen, for a more engaging user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: • Implemented functionality for setting up new investment accounts.

projects.title: Square Off
projects.description:
iOS App (UIGestureRecognizer, GADInterstitial)
App version of a game I designed where players race to move all their pawns to the other side of the board using movement patterns purchased in their inventory.

projects.title: Dividr Clone
projects.description:
iOS App (SpriteKit, GameplayKit, AVFoundation)
A clone of the Apple Design Award winning game Dividr that utilizes 3DTouch to play.
